title: BoxLang CLI
body: BoxLang CLI CBGenesis is a BoxLang application. Its box commands must be provided by the BoxLang-native bx-cli module. The regular Lucee-based CommandBox distribution is not supported for this template. title: Home
body: Get Started View on GitHub A production-ready ColdBox HMVC starter template for BoxLang - the modern, dynamic JVM language. title: Route Map
body: Route Map "Auth" means any authenticated user; a permission slug means the firewall also requires prc.authUser.hasPermission() to pass (see Security & Permissions ) — failing that redirects to dashboard.notAuthorized instead of login . Every POST , PUT , and DELETE route below requires a valid CSRF token in rc.csrf . GET routes do not — see CSRF verification . The :userId , :roleId , :permissionId…

title: App Settings
body: App Settings These live in SettingService.static.DEFAULTS , are seeded on boot by preFlightCheck() , cached with a 2-hour TTL, and editable at /settings by anyone with the settings:write (or settings:admin ) permission — see Configuration . title: Architecture
